name: e2e-dms
description: End-to-end Playwright automation for River DMS: Enquiry List, per-dealer GSTR sales with Post GST Discount from invoice PDFs, PDI blank vehicle details (Engine / Battery / Charger) filled from the VIN sheet, and a health check of all MIS reports, with Excel outputs, run-to-run comparison and email summaries; runs unattended on a server or CI/CD.

scripts.test:pdi:dry: npm run pdi:vin && set PDI_RUN=1&& set PDI_DRY_RUN=1&& playwright test "pdi/PDI.spec.ts" --headed
scripts.test:pdi: npm run pdi:vin && node "pdi/scripts/pdiSync.js" --pull && set PDI_RUN=1&& set PDI_DRY_RUN=&& playwright test "pdi/PDI.spec.ts" --headed & node "pdi/scripts/pdiSync.js"
scripts.test:pdi:intransit:dry: npm run pdi:vin && set PDI_RUN=1&& set PDI_DRY_RUN=1&& playwright test "pdi/PDI_Update_InTransit.spec.ts" --headed
scripts.test:pdi:intransit: npm run pdi:vin && node "pdi/scripts/pdiSync.js" --pull && set PDI_RUN=1&& set PDI_DRY_RUN=&& playwright test "pdi/PDI_Update_InTransit.spec.ts" --headed & node "pdi/scripts/pdiSync.js"
scripts.vin:master:dry: npm run pdi:vin && set PDI_RUN=1&& set PDI_DRY_RUN=1&& set PW_GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_MIN=1440&& playwright test "pdi/Vin_Master_update.spec.ts" --headed
scripts.vin:master: npm run pdi:vin && set PDI_RUN=1&& set PDI_DRY_RUN=&& set PW_GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_MIN=1440&& playwright test "pdi/Vin_Master_update.spec.ts" --headed
scripts.vin:master:report: set PDI_RUN=1&& set VIN_MASTER_REPORT=1&& playwright test "pdi/Vin_Master_update.spec.ts"
scripts.pdi:vin: git fetch origin vin-data && git show FETCH_HEAD:VIN_Details.csv > "resources/VIN_Details.csv"
scripts.report:pdi-daily: node "pdi/scripts/pdiSync.js" --pull && set PDI_RUN=1&& playwright test "pdi/PDIDailyReport.spec.ts" --reporter=line & node "pdi/scripts/pdiSync.js"
